banner.title: metrics-server
banner.tagline: Serves the metrics.k8s.io API that kubectl top, the descheduler and the dashboards read node and pod usage from.

explainer.title: From each kubelet to one metrics API

steps.title: Poll
steps.text: Every 15 seconds metrics-server asks each node's kubelet for CPU and memory, over the node status port.
steps.scene: three node blocks with signal pulses going up

steps.title: Hold
steps.text: It keeps only the latest sample in memory. There is no history store, so a restart empties the window.
steps.scene: a small memory chip holding a single snapshot

steps.title: Aggregate
steps.text: The API server proxies metrics.k8s.io to the metrics-server Service through an APIService object.
steps.scene: a routed arrow from a core hub to a service tower

steps.title: Read
steps.text: kubectl top, the descheduler and the HorizontalPodAutoscaler read the same API, and Prometheus scrapes the server.
steps.scene: dials and a graph panel fed by one cable
